modules.module_title: Identify prerequisites for the HMI/SCADA project

pcs.pc_description: collect detailed information about the plant and the customer’s requirements regarding the type of Human Machine Interface (HMI) panel/Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) system needed
identify the plant layout, the plant architecture and its complexity
identify the type and make of the Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) used in the control panel
examine the cut-out for HMI panel on the door of the control panel
identify the company/organisation approved software for to design HMI/SCADA system

test the communication protocol compatibility between PLC and HMI/SCADA and use protocol compatible cable for communication between PLC and HMI/SCADA or protocol convertor in case of non-compatibility
create HMI/SCADA project and establish a connection with the PLC
develop the I/O tag list in the HMI/SCADA project as well as the pictures on HMI/SCADA software as per the approved distribution
create objects on the pictures as per the final P&ID and connect them with tags
formulate value and alarm storage system in the software and create backup for the same
provide security level for different users of the project
create report templates for timely report generation

modules.module_title: Work as per the organisational team environment

pcs.pc_description: identify team objectives and goals, team members by name, their role and responsibilities, greet them appropriately and respond to their greetings

ensure equal treatment for all clients, colleagues and co-workers while respecting their personal space
